firstScreen.notes: dist/index.html: h1 'See the spec before you choose' + kicker 'Flooring · Atlanta, GA' states trade+city+outcome in ≤8 words. Primary action 'Compare floors' plus secondary 'Call' both above fold. Phone visible in header CTA and hero button. Proof bar peeks below svh-based hero. Chip stack signature visible in first screen.

distinctiveness.notes: dist/index.html: Sample Chip Cross-Section signature appears in hero (chip-stack data-sw-signature), services (chip--svc with chip__cross), reviews (chip--review with clip-path polygon), story-cross (data-sw-signature cross-diagram), and footer (chip--footer with initials). Five sections exceed ≥4 threshold. Three layout families: split-grid hero, full-bleed story pin, centered estimator wrap. Palette Georgia Clay+Bone+Terracotta unique per concept.json.

type.notes: dist/index.html: Archivo display (font-weight 600-700, tracking -0.03em on h1, line-height 0.92), Karla body at clamp(1rem-1.125rem) ≥16px, DM Mono for specs/kickers. Fluid scale with ≤5 sizes. Tabular numerals via font-variant-numeric. Lead paragraph set apart. Body measure capped at 72ch/60ch. No orphans detectable in static HTML.

layout.notes: dist/index.html: 10 sections each with one job. Alternating tones t-paper→t-mid→t-light→t-deep→t-paper→t-light→t-mid→t-accent→t-deep→t-paper→t-deep. No two dark bands touch. Full-bleed break photo provides breath. Asymmetric moisture grid. Centered estimator breaks grid intentionally. Deduction −0.5: services chip-grid uses identical chip--svc shape 10 times in a row, reads as template grid rather than varied layout families.

photo.notes: dist/index.html: All images have descriptive alt text, width/height, loading=lazy, decoding=async. Photo grade filter applied consistently via CSS. Object-fit cover on all frames. Distinct data-photo values (hands-sample, detail-grain-whiteoak, process-moisture, home-atlanta). Deduction −1.0: all images are placeholders with generic 'Placeholder for...' alt text; cannot verify on-topic framing or crop ratios without actual media. Expected placeholder ceiling.

copy.notes: dist/index.html: Voice matches concept sample sentences with specific nouns (wear layer, slab moisture, 12 mil, SPC core). No banned phrases. Buttons named for actions (Compare floors, Book a moisture test, Check my slab, Calculate, Send these numbers). Sample labels on every review card, rating, and pricing. Primary action consistent. Microcopy at form steps. H1 is 6 words. No tricolons or filler.

mobile.notes: dist/index.html CSS: Hero stacks below 900px. Chip-stack 2-col at 640px+, 1-col below. Services 1→2→4 col. Reviews 1→2→3 col. Footer 1→2→4 col. Mobile bar fixed with 80px body padding, hidden ≥900px. All buttons min-height 48px, inputs height 48px. Flex-wrap on btn-row and pills prevents horizontal scroll. Skip link present.

a11y.notes: dist/index.html: Skip link to #contact. Focus-visible 3px solid var(--focus) with 3px offset. All inputs have explicit label elements. aria-live=polite on compare-output, checklist-output, est-output, zip-output, form-thankyou. aria-expanded/aria-controls on menu button. aria-label on star ratings. aria-hidden on decorative icons. Reduced-motion resets all reveals/clips/transforms. No-JS fallback makes all content visible. Heading order correct (one h1, h2 per section, h3 subsections).

motion.notes: dist/index.html: Intro chip-stack stagger via data-reveal-stagger with --d-stagger delay cascade. Story-cross pinned at calc(3*55svh+100svh) with cross-layer translateY animation and label fade. Hover btn-text underline scaleX(0→1). Reduced motion fully respected. ≥3 hooks: staggered unclip, cross-section peel, clip reveals. Deduction −0.5: most sections use same translateY+opacity reveal; only chip-stack and story-cross have distinct verbs. Deduction −0.5: pinned story height borderline at ~2.6 screens.

wow.notes: dist/index.html: Material Compare tool in hero produces four-column comparison tied to spec-first thesis. Cross-section peel story explains mil numbers physically. Both moments trade-specific and thesis-connected. Deduction −0.5: cannot verify compare output is designed in signature language without JS execution; may render as plain text in aria-live div.

polish.notes: dist/index.html: SVG favicon + apple-touch-icon referenced. OG 1200x630 declared. JSON-LD HomeAndConstructionBusiness with openingHoursSpecification. Theme-color set. Consistent radius 2px (999px pills intentional). Print stylesheet for estimator. Lazy images with dimensions. Hero image preloaded. Forced colors handled. Deduction −0.5: cannot verify shadow consistency or icon stroke uniformity without visual inspection.

elevate.move: Apply the chip clip-path polygon as a mask on the break photo and story-cross background texture when real media arrives, so the signature frame literally shapes the photography into concept-specific artifacts.

Break the services chip-grid monotony by introducing a featured-service variant spanning two columns with an embedded micro-diagram (cross-section inset showing wear/print/core for LVP), creating a density peak and loud-quiet-loud scroll rhythm.
